steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Why... doesn't this damn place... have... an elevator?
Shawn pants heavily as she climbs the stairs, her sedentary lifestyle finally taking its toll on her today.
This is the address given by the technical department from tracking "Slumber under Cherry"'s mobile signals. It's also the highest rooftop you can find near Seaside Residence 1902.
Moments later, you finally reach the end of the stairs.
Under the neon lights of Eastside, the girl stands on the edge of the rooftop. As if expecting you, she watches quietly as you open the door to the rooftop and walk toward her.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Long time no see.
Shawn raises her hand, flashing a signature smile.
The girl doesn't answer but instead turns her head to look at the city beyond the rooftop.
You move a few steps forward surreptitiously. Noticing your movement, Shawn turns back nervously, meaning for you to let her handle it.
The shackles are useless in this situation. Without them, you're just a stranger with lower-than-average physical abilities.
Approaching the vulnerable girl on the brink of a mental breakdown without a plan is indeed not a rational decision. Thinking this, you silently take a step back.
Seeing that you've taken her word, Shawn breathes a sigh of relief and smiles as she turns back.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: You don't seem surprised.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I'm the person who's been talking to you online. "Hopeless Romantic".

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: I know.
The girl finally responds but doesn't look in your direction.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Hah, sorry, I don't look like those pictures I sent you.
Shawn brushes the dust off her chest, trying to appear more presentable.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Anyway, this is officially our first meeting. Don't you have anything to say?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Never mind. If you can't think of anything, I'll start.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: What are you doing here alone?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Isn't it obvious?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: I'm going to jump.
Despite her horrific words, the girl never turns around, her tone eerily calm.
Compared to that hysterical version of her a few hours ago, she seems like a completely different person.
Shawn edges closer cautiously.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Won't you turn around and look at me? Look closely, I look nothing like that imaginary figure who's there with you every day. And I can't replace your sister.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: A despicable liar like me is going to get the punishment I deserve. I came to say goodbye. Isn't that a good thing?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Don't do such a foolish thing for someone like me. It's not worth it.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: The old you would be celebrating with your friends now, right? Going shopping together, staying up all night watching anime, and lying around cursing the scum who wasted your youth...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Hey, there's no need for all this.
The girl turns around, her expression so cold it's almost terrifying.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Like you said, that's the old me.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Don't you remember? You've ruined her.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: The past should be made up of memories of love. That's why I don't have a past now.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: After all, the people I've loved are no longer here.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: I loved my sister, and she was gone without an explanation. I loved you, and you vanished, leaving behind not even a single message.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Now, I only have "Hopeless Romantic" to lean on... I've been surviving on that little affection from the person you made up.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: But you, Shawn, what have you done?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: You said you'd leave me. You're going to take away the kind, patient "Hopeless Romantic" who would treat a loser like me with care... You're going to rob me of that!

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Everyone I've loved ended up like this... How cheap can my love be? It always gets tossed away like trash...

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Tell me, why should I go on living? Give me a reason to live, Shawn!
Seeing the girl step closer to the dangerous edge, Shawn shouts to stop her.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Here! I'll give you a reason! Just give me a second...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Right! ...Love is indeed a wonderful thing. I'll admit that. But love certainly isn't all there is in life!

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: There's still so much more worth living for! Like...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Like the final episode of White Tuxedo Mask airing at midnight today! Are you sure you wanna go without seeing how it ends?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Besides anime, there are the pretty dresses in your closet, your chubby cat Lumi...
Shawn speaks frantically, all the while inching closer toward the girl.
But you notice the girl on the edge of the rooftop takes a step back, a disturbing smile appearing on her face.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Liar.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Do you even believe what you're saying?
Her persuasion interrupted, Shawn freezes.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: If there are so many things worth living for, why do you spend all your time chatting with strangers online?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Because you're searching for "love"...

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: I know I'm not the one you're looking for. It's okay, as long as you are who I'm looking for...

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: But you said you're leaving! You've been lying to yourself, yet you refuse to keep lying to me!
Shawn is rendered speechless. The girl turns around, and jumps.
You instantly realize what's about to happen. But it's too late.
The girl's dress billows in the night wind of Eastside, like a colorful kite that no longer aspires to the sky, dropping lifelessly from your sight.
At the same moment, Shawn leaps over without a second thought, stretching out her arm with all her might, half of her body reaching out, leaving only her legs on the rooftop.
When you rush to her side, you find her gripping the girl's wrist tightly.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Ha... Ha...
Gravity's pull on an adult is so heavy that Shawn, whose body lacks any regular training, immediately pays the price with a dislocated shoulder. The pain contorts her face, making her shake all over.
If you hadn't grabbed Shawn's waist in time, she would undoubtedly have been pulled to the ground along with the girl.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Haha... Hahaha... You ******* idiot...
The girl glares coldly at the person who's just saved her but also cursed her. Even you can't exactly read Shawn's feelings now.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: You ******* idiot...
She curses again.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: So, just because I'm leaving you, you must give up your life?
She throws her head back with a loud laugh, completely ignoring the awkward position the three of you are in. She whips her head around.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Chief, let me ask you!

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: What will you do if I tell you I love you?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: And what if I persist?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: And if I keep making new accounts to send you friend requests?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: But have I ever given up?!
For some reason, the questions and answers stir up your emotions too.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Right. You guys are right. I'm addicted to the internet because I want to find "love"!

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I became the messed-up person I am because I was framed by the person I trusted the most at the voice actor contest. It ruined my voice and my career. But even so, I just want to find back that love that betrayed me!

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: If I get rejected, I'll keep trying. If that fails too, I'll find someone else to love.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: If one person's love isn't enough, then I'll have ten, or a hundred.
The girl looks up confusedly at the increasingly unfamiliar "Hopeless Romantic", but Shawn is undeterred by her reaction, going on with her speech while tearing off her own affectionate façade.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: You know, being loved by so many is indeed a wonderful feeling. I, for one, am completely addicted to it.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Right, you should try it too. Forget about your sister and Shawn. What's one person's love when you can get it from ten or a hundred people?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: You're so pretty and have such a sweet voice. You can easily win everyone's love.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: You're... crazy...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I'm not crazy. You're crazy... for not wanting all the love out there!

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I'm born to be a vagabond of love, a heartbreaker who's never lonely. And I'm the most self-aware and happiest person in the whole DisCity!
As Shawn says this, her body strains to coordinate with your movements. You grab Shawn while planting your feet firmly on the edge of the rooftop, pulling both of you back inch by inch.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Give it a try. Just once and you'll be hooked...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: After all, those are just fickle feelings destined to fade. Those people won't suffer any real loss, right?
Shawn has exhausted all her strength. In the end, even her voice has grown hoarse.
You can feel Shawn's body getting weaker, and with a dislocated arm, she's got no more strength to talk, let alone grab the girl.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Try it. Once you get used to it... you can forget...
Finally, with one last pull, you drag the two of them back from the edge of the rooftop.

The three of you collapse on the rooftop. Other than the sound of the wind, you hear only Shawn's heavy gasps that sound like she's concealing something. It could be her shoulder injury, or something else.

The operators arrive quickly upon your order, immediately proceeding to examine the girl's injury from the failed jump. You and Shawn remain on the rooftop, seemingly still recovering from the narrowly averted crisis.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Oh no, I've spilled everything. Now all my mystery's gone... Are you happy now, Chief?
She pretends to joke casually while turning her back so you can't see her expression at that moment. It must be the most vulnerable look after revealing her scars.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You were really cool just now. Your vocal fry actually sounds sexier when you're not trying too hard to flirt.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Vocal fry? You sure know how to flatter me. My voice got destroyed by poison.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Doesn't matter. At least it's real. Same as the kindness you showed when trying to pull someone out of the same darkness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're more charming and deserving of love than "Hopeless Romantic", Shawn.
She turns around in a daze. The city lights shine on Shawn, the colorful hues seeming to highlight the scars on this fragile body she's patched up herself.
Ding. A notification pops up on Shawn's phone. "Slumber under Cherry" removed you from her friend list.
The only slightly shocking but overly melodramatic incident finally comes to an end.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Don't you have work today?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Or have my long endeavors finally paid off... Did the seed of love sprout in your heart? Did it finally bloom?
You have some important things to tell her today.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...In short, she's currently undergoing therapy. Her mood is stable now, with nothing out of the ordinary.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The medical staff are my acquaintances. She's in good hands.
Hearing your updates, Shawn simply waves her hand unconcernedly.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: You don't need to tell me all this. I trust you will handle this perfectly.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Why don't you divert that attention to me...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's just a dislocated shoulder. You'll be fine after a few days of rest.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I'm not talking about my body, but my heart.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Sigh, these past days have been tough. It seems like everyone at the Bureau is already taken, seeing that they're all immune to my charms.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: It's gotten to the point where I'm starting to doubt myself... Am I ugly? Or is my voice too unpleasant... What exactly is the issue?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Have you already moved on, having just broken up with your online lovers?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Do you really need to be in love with tens or hundreds of people to fill the void in your heart?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: It was just some excuse I made up to stop the girl from attempting the foolish act. You don't actually believe it, do you?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: And there's no void in my heart now. After all, it's already fully occupied by one single person.
Meeting Shawn's affectionate gaze, you can already guess what she's about to say.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: That person achieved what I couldn't, saving a girl who almost fell to the bottom of the darkness.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: That person has seen all of my ugliness, but still looks at me without any judgment.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: That person denied what I said, refused my love, but still won't let go of me, will never let go of anyone within reach, like a saint from some fairy tale...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: That person said I had to pay for my mistakes in captivity for the rest of my life. And I... I'm only too willing.
Your head throbs at Shawn's passionate monologue.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You were literally just looking for new prey in the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Well, I guess you can say that.
Shawn leans in closer to you, her eyes filled with innocence.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: After all, I don't know how else to get your attention.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Am I a powerful Sinner? No. Do I have any special talents? None.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I'm just an invisible nobody here. Why would you pay special attention to me?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I've tried all the methods I know, but it seems none of them work on you.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: What's your type? Tell me. I can learn to change...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I know I'm a liar, a worthless scum... Maybe everything about me is fake, but my love is the only real thing.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I'm willing to change for you, to atone for my crimes in captivity for the rest of my life, just as you wish... I'm willing to do all that. I just hope all these humble efforts... can earn me a chance.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Give me a chance to be the person you desire, will you?
You're completely unprepared for Shawn's heartfelt speech. However, seeing her earnest expression, you don't have the heart to reject her with your previous cold attitude.
So the two of you simply stare at each other in silence. Shawn bursts into sudden laughter.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Hahaha.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: That worked, didn't it?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Did you feel it? Did you get butterflies? Come on, be honest. Anyway, I think you did. Tell me the truth...
Shawn moves closer, getting bolder. You feel a chill down your spine and your body reacts instinctively.
Thump—
A clean and swift throw puts a perfect end to this imperfect story about love.
